issues.quote: Total assets stood at $365.0 million at the end of fiscal 2024
issues.problem: Wrong unit: Apple's total assets were about $365.0 billion ($364.98B), not $365.0 million.

data.summary: Most figures are correct: revenue was $391.0B, up 2.0% from $383.3B; net income was $93.7B; operating income was $123.2B; and cash and cash equivalents were $29.9B. Total assets is wrong because it says million instead of billion. The 'pre-verified' line in the text doesn't confirm any figures, so I checked each one myself.
